emit_lag_growth_seconds.definition: delivered_monotonic span minus model time_s span between a session's first and last live_emit

asr_evidence.first_session_stall: the pause replay still delivered a 4.06s lump in the second request of the first real session (warmup reduced the earlier total-swallow case); all later sessions were a clean 0.09-0.10s per request
